name: Vencillón (Spain)
description: Green field with a wavy band of white and blue stripes across the centre, charged with a blue oval edged white bearing yellow ears of wheat, with two small shields of the bars of Aragon at the upper hoist and the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Vencillón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

blue wavy stripes of the band
